description: Three doorknob 'claw' grips with the right hand, palm toward the camera, as if turning a knob at eye level: knuckles straight, fingertips curled, thumb out. Each is twisted back and forth (about 50 degrees each way), with the hand opened flat between them: claws at 0.9-4.4 s, 6.5-10.3 s and 12.0-15.4 s, open hand at 4.8-6.2, 10.6-11.7 and 15.7-16.4 s. Then an ordinary fist (16.8-20.6 s). Each claw should engage once as a claw and the fist once as a fist; nothing else should engage. MediaPipe labels the hand Left for the first frame and around 20.7 s. Recorded from a live webcam at 640x480 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data (~30 fps); labels are as the tracker sees them.
